num_questions_note: Confirmed: 100 one-mark objective MCQs, 100 marks, 2 hours. Cross-checked against the ICAI sample paper (syllabus/SA May 2025 QA.pdf: 100 questions, Q1-40 Business Mathematics, Q41-60 Logical Reasoning, Q61-100 Statistics) and ICAI exam-pattern sources. Per-part question counts follow the 40/20/40 mark split at one mark each.

pass.sectional_min_note: No sectional minimum within Paper 3. The 40 percent bar is on the paper total, net of negative marking.
pass.aggregate_note: The 50% aggregate is across all four Foundation papers and is out of scope for a QA-only app. Readiness here anchors on the 40% single-paper bar.

readiness_anchor: A predicted Paper 3 mark of 40 out of 100, net of negative marking, is the pass threshold. Readiness is shown as distance to this anchor, honestly labelled as an estimate until empirical calibration exists.
sources: syllabus/SA May 2025 QA.pdf — ICAI sample paper, May 2025 (100 questions; Q1-40 Business Mathematics, Q41-60 Logical Reasoning, Q61-100 Statistics)
confidence: Question count (100), total marks (100), duration (2 hours), four-option objective format, negative marking (0.25 per wrong), and the 40% single-paper pass are confirmed across the ICAI sample paper and ICAI sources. Per-part question counts (40/20/40) are inferred from the confirmed 40/20/40 mark split at one mark per question, consistent with the sample paper's section boundaries.
